prompt: Classify the sentiment of the following sentence. Answer with exactly one label: positive or negative. Do not provide any explanation.
checkpoint_note: Checkpoint disk size includes components not necessarily loaded when enable_audio_output=False; loaded parameters and runtime memory are reported separately.
throughput_note: Request QPS values are sequential batch-1 service-rate proxies (1000 / mean latency), not load-tested concurrent throughput.
memory_note: Torch allocator memory is framework-specific auxiliary data; final deployment VRAM comparison will use process-level NVML.

latency_definition.model_latency: synchronized model.generate() only, after processor execution and H2D transfer
latency_definition.e2e_latency: task prompt/message build + chat template + processor/tokenization + H2D + model.generate() + generated-token slicing + decode + closed-label normalization
